admission_dependency: Identity must first refine one-time delivery and any combined reveal/requested-local-download permission. Current UI concept is inert and not a second grant. No live recovery value may be used to qualify a new boundary.
invariants: Keep existing TOTP v2/v3 literal registries, acceptDownloads:false and empty non-profile artifact rules. No global switch, folder/extension allowlist, reporter override or secret-bearing test-runner invocation.

Use a separate literal recovery journey/canary registration with fixed required component-owned predicates and fixed module dispatch. No arbitrary module, callback, shell, output path or policy injection from control input.

Use the existing protected raw-browser process, environment isolation, bounded private control, source/build binding and owned-resource cleanup mechanics. Current surface path grammar is P2-008-only; any P2-009 adaptation must be a separately reviewed static grammar/reuse seam, not an arbitrary-root validator.

The only candidate download input is the already held authorized transient payload from the one-time response. No server read-again, plaintext escrow, status-to-code endpoint or blind regeneration. Loss before possession stays nondisclosing.

Default state is DISARMED. Arm exactly one request immediately before the explicit approved action in the owning page/context and operation. Every unsolicited, second, popup/iframe, stale-operation or post-disposal download rejects the run even if its bytes look benign.

If Blob/objectURL is chosen, allow only the owning page's opaque local temporary capability and revoke it on completion/exit. Never place codes in data: URLs, query/fragment, filenames, navigation, storage or exported URL fields. Exact transport mechanism remains reviewed, not implemented here.

Do not trust suggestedFilename, download.url or download.failure as safe diagnostics. Never print them. Browser-generated path must resolve to one regular nonlinked file under the exact newly owned download root; reject traversal, alternate roots, symlinks/reparse ambiguity and changed file identity. Do not saveAs a user/global directory.

Count and size limits are finite reviewed test-protocol constants derived from the selected supported profile, not business defaults. Inspect the bounded stream only inside the protected child; compare exactly to its held payload and return booleans. Do not export bytes, digest, code list, assertion diff, download path or raw errors to coordinator/evidence.

An admitted file is permitted only during its exact transfer/inspection interval. All other artifact roots remain empty. Reconcile live inventory with the exact admitted identity; deleting an unexpected artifact does not convert the boundary to PASS.

After bounded complete/cancel, call bounded artifact deletion and verify actual file absence, closed context/browser/child, clean owned surface and surface removal. A timed-out API promise alone is not cleanup. Use known-owned-process containment fallback, then verify actual close/absence; forced termination or unknown cleanup rejects acceptance under the existing contract.

Clear references/DOM on Done, close, operation change and cancellation; dispose object URLs/streams/buffers where applicable. Do not claim managed-string, OS-memory or global-filesystem erasure. User-facing feedback proves request initiation, never user-save/backup confirmation.

Neither coordinator nor supervisor receives recovery codes. Coordinator proves actual owner/persistence/resource observations; browser proves actual DOM/download/private-surface observations. Neither echoes the other's asserted PASS inputs. Missing/false/unknown/extra/cross-component predicates reject acceptance.

test_layer_ownership.native_integration: The test process privately owns generated inputs and tests actual verifier rows, native token fallback absence, atomic state/outbox and safe diagnostics. Use fixed boolean assertions, never expected-secret assertion rendering.
test_layer_ownership.real_browser_child: Owns volatile response and one admitted download; bounded byte equality and clearing are checked internally. No secret fixture value goes into argv, env, file-based control, IPC receipt or HTTP test oracle.
test_layer_ownership.coordinator: Structured actual safe-column/token/outbox audit and exact resource cleanup; source-proven write paths plus native tests complement browser evidence. Do not forward codes to expand a database scan or claim exhaustive global database/host absence.
test_layer_ownership.supervisor: Owns finite lifetime, raw-output rejection, known process identities and exact owned-root removal. Keep failure envelopes representable but non-accepting.

public_fault_canaries_required_before_li: One armed public fixture download with expected public bytes, actual bounded stream check and removal through the exact new registration
Unexpected and duplicate downloads before/after admission; wrong page/context/operation and race with close
Wrong content, zero/oversized/truncated content, adversarial suggested name and owned-path/link mismatch
Timeout/cancellation at start, partial transfer, stream failure, delete failure and controller/child termination
Public marker in raw stdout/stderr, thrown download error, assertion-like text, unexpected file or attempted capture
Missing/false/extra predicates, malformed control/result and valid failed envelope; failure remains failure
Existing TOTP public boundary matrix still rejects download artifacts and retains all original output controls
unresolved_technical_facts_before_implem: Final owner admission semantics and exact UI consent scope for requested download
Pinned Playwright actual download staging path/lifecycle under the reviewed configuration, before allowing any secret file
Exact static module/path ownership and finite transfer/stream/delete/time/size budgets
How the single admitted file identity is reconciled during live inventory without admitting unrelated artifacts
Public canary outcomes and committed source/build binding for the new recovery boundary

existing_library_seam.scope: Download.path/createReadStream/cancel/delete delegate to Artifact; path waits for completion and can throw. types/types.d.ts documents context-close deletion. These are reuse candidates, not proof of bounded cleanup or an executed download.
